prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury attorney for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, injuries, insurance limits, and whether you want or need a firm with big trial resources. That said, Chicago has many highly regarded personal-injury firms and trial lawyers who handle car-accident claims.

How to find the right attorney
- Look for experience with car-accident cases (including catastrophic injury and wrongful death if relevant).
- Check trial experience and whether the firm has resources to handle expensive cases (experts, investigators).
- Review past case results and client reviews (Avvo, Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell).
- Confirm they handle cases on contingency (no fee unless you recover) and their fee/split if the case goes to suit.
- Verify license and disciplinary history with the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission.
- Choose a lawyer you can communicate with and who responds promptly.

Chicago firms commonly recommended for car-accident/personal-injury work
(These are examples of well-known Chicago personal-injury firms — I’m not declaring any one “best.” Contact several to see who’s the best fit for your case.)
- Clifford Law Offices
- Corboy & Demetrio
- Levin & Perconti
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard
- Power Rogers & Smith
- Kopon Airdo (and other regional trial firms)

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled?
- What percentage of your cases settle vs. go to trial?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What are your fees and expenses? (Typical contingency is about one-third but can vary.)
- Can you provide references or client testimonials?
- What results have you obtained for similar injuries?

Practical next steps
- Act promptly — Illinois’s general statute of limitations for personal-injury claims is two years from the accident (exceptions apply).
- Collect and save police reports, medical records, photos, witness info, and correspondence with insurers.
- If you want, tell me brief facts about your accident (date, injuries, fault questions, location) and your priorities (fast settlement vs. large recovery vs. trial-ready). I can then give a shorter, tailored list of attorneys or help draft an email/phone script for consultations.
